nodes.label: Manual Event Sourcing Rationale
nodes.rationale: Manual event sourcing with PostgreSQL JSONB keeps the project simple and educational.

nodes.label: Outbox Pattern Rationale
nodes.rationale: Guarantees events are published whenever the aggregate is mutated, without a separate message broker.

nodes.label: Async Projection Rationale
nodes.rationale: GET endpoints no longer rehydrate the aggregate, improving read performance.

nodes.label: Idempotency Rationale
nodes.rationale: POST endpoints require Idempotency-Key to safely retry commands.

nodes.label: idempotency_records
nodes.rationale: Idempotency record table refined to remove transient rows and enforce response_payload non-nullity.

nodes.label: idempotency_records.aggregate_version
nodes.rationale: Added to idempotency_records in changeSet 003 and later removed in changeSet 010 as the idempotency scheme evolved.

nodes.label: outbox_events
nodes.rationale: Transactional outbox table storing domain events to be published reliably to downstream consumers.

nodes.label: outbox_events.aggregate_version
nodes.rationale: Enforces ordering and uniqueness of events per aggregate via a composite unique constraint.

nodes.label: outbox_events.processing_attempts
nodes.rationale: Tracks the number of times an outbox event publication was attempted, enabling retry semantics.

nodes.label: credit_account_summary
nodes.rationale: Read model projection summarizing the state of a credit account for query workloads.

nodes.label: credit_account_summary.projected_version
nodes.rationale: Captures the aggregate version projected into the read model to ensure ordering and idempotency.

nodes.label: credit_account_summary.last_event_id
nodes.rationale: Captures the last event ID applied to the read model for idempotency and recovery.

nodes.label: outbox_consumers
nodes.rationale: Registry of outbox consumers enabling per-consumer delivery tracking and control.

nodes.label: credit-account-summary-projector
nodes.rationale: Consumer that projects outbox events into the credit_account_summary read model.

nodes.label: outbox_deliveries
nodes.rationale: Tracks per-consumer delivery state for each outbox event with locking and retry controls.

nodes.label: outbox_deliveries.status
nodes.rationale: State machine values (PENDING, PROCESSING, PROCESSED, BLOCKED, FAILED) model the delivery lifecycle per consumer.

nodes.label: outbox_deliveries.processing_attempts
nodes.rationale: Tracks delivery attempts per consumer, supporting individual consumer retry semantics.

nodes.label: outbox_deliveries.max_attempts
nodes.rationale: Default cap of 10 attempts prevents unbounded retry of failing deliveries.

nodes.label: Outbox Delivery State Machine
nodes.rationale: Mechanism to track and control per-consumer event delivery state with explicit terminal and retry states.

nodes.label: projection_checkpoints
nodes.rationale: Stores per-projection, per-aggregate progress so projectors can resume and avoid duplicate application.

nodes.label: projection_checkpoints.last_projected_version
nodes.rationale: Captures the last projected aggregate version per projection to enable resume and exactly-once semantics.

nodes.label: projection_checkpoints.last_event_id
nodes.rationale: Captures the last projected event ID per projection.

nodes.label: Backfill Outbox Deliveries
nodes.rationale: Bootstraps delivery records for previously existing outbox events so the new per-consumer delivery tracking applies retroactively.

nodes.label: Drop Idempotency Aggregate Version
nodes.rationale: Removes the aggregate_version column from idempotency_records, reversing the change introduced in changeSet 003.
